FACEBOOK.tail: Error validating access token · the token is no longer valid
(#4) Application request limit reached · the app hit its rate limit
FACEBOOK.fix: Wait for the window to reset, then retry, and lower your call volume.

FACEBOOK.tail: (#17) User request limit reached · this user made too many calls
(#32) Page request limit reached · the Page hit its rate limit
(#613) Calls to this api have exceeded the rate limit · an endpoint rate limit was hit
(#10) Application does not have permission for this action · a permission is missing
FACEBOOK.fix: Ask the user to log in again and grant every requested permission; check the app has Advanced Access for it.

FACEBOOK.tail: (#200) Requires … publish_pages as an admin · the user can't post to this Page
(#100) Invalid parameter · a field is missing or wrong
The action attempted has been deemed abusive… · Meta has blocked this action for now
(#506) Duplicate status message · the same text was just posted to this Page

This person isn't available right now · the person can't receive messages

INSTAGRAM.tail: (#10) Application does not have permission for this action · a permission is missing

INSTAGRAM.tail: (#100) Invalid parameter · a field is missing or wrong
The media could not be fetched from this uri · Meta couldn't download the media
INSTAGRAM.fix: Make sure the media URL is public, returns the file directly (no redirect to a login page) and is a JPEG/PNG image or MP4/MOV video.

INSTAGRAM.tail: The submitted image with aspect ratio … cannot be published · the image shape isn't allowed
INSTAGRAM.fix: Crop the image to between 4:5 and 1.91:1.

INSTAGRAM.tail: The media is not ready for publishing, please wait for a moment · the container isn't finished
INSTAGRAM.fix: Poll the container's `status_code` and publish only when it is `FINISHED`.

INSTAGRAM.tail: You reached maximum number of posts… · the 24-hour publishing limit
(#10) This message is sent outside of allowed window · the 24-hour reply window has closed
This person isn't available right now · the person can't receive messages
INSTAGRAM.fix: Nothing to fix on your side: the person blocked the Page or turned off messages.

THREADS.tail: Error validating access token · the token is no longer valid
(#4) Application request limit reached · the app hit its rate limit
THREADS.fix: Wait for the window to reset, then retry, and lower your call volume.

THREADS.tail: (#10) Application does not have permission for this action · a permission is missing
THREADS.fix: Ask the user to log in again and grant every requested permission; check the app has Advanced Access for it.

THREADS.tail: (#100) Invalid parameter · a field is missing or wrong
The action attempted has been deemed abusive… · Meta has blocked this action for now
Only photo or video can be accepted as media type · Threads couldn't read the media
THREADS.fix: Make sure the media URL is public, returns the file directly (no redirect to a login page) and is a JPEG/PNG image or MP4/MOV video.

THREADS.tail: Media ID is not available · the container isn't finished
THREADS.fix: Poll the container's `status_code` and publish only when it is `FINISHED`.

THREADS.tail: THREADS_API__LINK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED · more than five links in one post

TWITTER.tail: Unauthorized · the token is invalid or revoked
TWITTER.fix: Refresh the OAuth 2.0 token with the refresh token; if that fails, have the user authorize the app again.

TWITTER.tail: Your enrolled account does not have any credits… · the X credit balance is empty
You are not allowed to create a Tweet with duplicate content · the same text was just posted
Reply to this Tweet is not allowed… · replies are limited to conversations you're part of
This user is not allowed to post a video longer than 20 minutes · the video is too long for this account
Your Tweet text is too long · the text is over 280 characters
TWITTER.fix: Shorten it to 280 weighted characters (links count 23, emoji 2), or split it into a thread.

TWITTER.tail: Client Forbidden · the app isn't attached to a project
Quoting is not available on this access tier · your access level can't quote
One or more parameters to your request was invalid · a field failed X's checks
Your media IDs are invalid · the media id expired or failed
TWITTER.fix: Upload the media again and use the new id within 24 hours.

TWITTER.tail: Could not find tweet with id · the post doesn't exist or is protected
Too Many Requests · a rate-limit window is used up
TWITTER.fix: Wait until the `x-rate-limit-reset` time (a Unix timestamp), then retry.

LINKEDIN.tail: The token used in the request has been revoked by the user · the member's token is gone
LINKEDIN.fix: Send the member through LinkedIn sign-in again. Access tokens last 60 days; refresh tokens only exist for apps LinkedIn has approved for them.

LINKEDIN.tail: Not enough permissions to access: partnerApiPostsExternal.CREATE · a scope or API product is missing
LINKEDIN.fix: Ask the member to sign in again and accept every scope. Posting as a company page needs the Community Management API on your app.

LINKEDIN.tail: Content is a duplicate of urn:li:share:… · the same post text was just used
Content cannot be empty · the post has no text
Resource level throttle APPLICATION DAY limit… · the app's daily quota is used up
LINKEDIN.fix: Wait for the reset at midnight UTC, then retry.

LINKEDIN.tail: Requested version … is not active · the API version you sent is retired
Media asset urn:li:image:… is not available · the uploaded file isn't ready or is gone
LINKEDIN.fix: Wait until the asset's status is `AVAILABLE`; if it never gets there, upload it again.

LINKEDIN.tail: Unpermitted fields present in REQUEST_BODY · a field combination isn't allowed
Not Found · the post doesn't exist or isn't yours
(no error; the post is cut off at the first unescaped ( or [) · reserved characters weren't escaped
LINKEDIN.fix: Escape LinkedIn's reserved characters in `commentary` (for example `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`) with a backslash.

TIKTOK.tail: Unaudited clients can only post to a private account · the app hasn't passed TikTok's audit
privacy_level is not one of the creator's privacy_level_options · that privacy level isn't allowed for this creator
TIKTOK.fix: Call `creator_info` first and use one of the `privacy_level_options` it returns.

TIKTOK.tail: The daily post cap from the API is reached… · the creator hit the daily post cap
Too many pending shares in the inbox · too many drafts are waiting
TIKTOK.fix: Have the creator post or delete pending drafts in the TikTok app.

TIKTOK.tail: The user is banned from posting · TikTok has blocked this creator
The access token is invalid or not found in the request · the token expired or was revoked
TIKTOK.fix: Refresh the token with the refresh token; if that fails, have the creator authorize the app again.

TIKTOK.tail: The user did not authorize the scope required… · a permission wasn't granted
TIKTOK.fix: Have the creator authorize again and approve `video.publish` or `video.upload`.

TIKTOK.tail: The URL prefix is not verified for this app · the media domain isn't verified
API rate limit exceeded · too many requests for this token
TIKTOK.fix: Each user token allows 6 requests a minute on these endpoints; wait a minute, then retry.

TIKTOK.tail: Video duration exceeds the creator's max_video_post_duration_sec · the video is too long for this creator
TIKTOK.fix: Read `max_video_post_duration_sec` from `creator_info` and trim the video to fit.

TIKTOK.tail: Unsupported media format · TikTok can't use this file
Picture size check failed · the photo is too large
The daily quota for active publishing users from your client is reached · the app hit its daily cap on posting users
TIKTOK.fix: Wait for the next day. The cap rises after the app passes TikTok's audit.

TIKTOK.tail: No permission to operate this business account · the Business API token lacks access
TIKTOK.fix: Authorize again with the business scopes, on a TikTok business account.

TIKTOK.tail: Access token is invalid or expired · the Business API token expired
TIKTOK.fix: Refresh the token; if that fails, authorize again.

YOUTUBE.tail: Invalid Credentials · the token expired or access was revoked
YOUTUBE.fix: Refresh the token with the refresh token; if that fails, have the user sign in with Google again.

YOUTUBE.tail: …you have exceeded your quota · the project's daily quota is spent
The user has exceeded the number of videos they may upload · the channel hit its daily upload limit
…doesn't have permissions to upload and set custom video thumbnails · custom thumbnails need a verified channel
Unauthorized · the Google account has no YouTube channel
YOUTUBE.fix: Create a channel at youtube.com, then sign in again.

YOUTUBE.tail: …invalid or empty video title · the title is empty, too long or has < >
…invalid video description · the description is too long or has < >
Video already in playlist · it's already there
…has disabled comments · comments are off on this video
rejectionReason: duplicate | copyright | claim | length | termsOfUse … · YouTube refused the video after processing
YOUTUBE.fix: Read `status.rejectionReason`; fix the content and upload again.

YOUTUBE.tail: privacyStatus came back private although public was requested · the video was set to private

PINTEREST.tail: Authentication failed · the token expired or the app was removed
PINTEREST.fix: Refresh the token; if that fails, have the user authorize the app again.

PINTEREST.tail: Your application consumer type is not supported / Trial access · the app only has Trial access
Not authorized to access this resource · a scope is missing
PINTEREST.fix: Have the user authorize again and accept every scope (for example `boards:write` and `user_accounts:read`).

PINTEREST.tail: Board not found · no board with that name
PINTEREST.fix: Use an existing board's id or exact name, or create the board first.

PINTEREST.tail: Pin not found · the Pin was deleted or isn't yours
Invalid image URL / the image could not be fetched · Pinterest couldn't download the image
PINTEREST.fix: Use a public JPEG or PNG URL under 20 MB.

PINTEREST.tail: Invalid parameters · a field failed Pinterest's checks
The media is not ready / cover image is required · the video isn't processed or has no cover
PINTEREST.fix: Wait until the media status is `succeeded` before creating the Pin, and send a cover image.

PINTEREST.tail: You have exceeded your rate limit · the rate limit is used up
PINTEREST.fix: Wait for the reset, then retry; spread Pin creation out.

PINTEREST.tail: Internal Server Error · Pinterest is having trouble

REDDIT.tail: Unauthorized · the token expired or was revoked
REDDIT.fix: Refresh the token; if that fails, have the user authorize the app again.

REDDIT.tail: Forbidden · the subreddit is private, quarantined or banned for this account
you are doing that too much. try again in 9 minutes. · the account is posting too often
REDDIT.fix: Wait the time named in the message. New and low-karma accounts get longer waits.

REDDIT.tail: that subreddit doesn't exist · there's no subreddit by that name
you aren't allowed to post there. · the subreddit doesn't accept posts from this account
Your post must contain post flair. · the subreddit requires a flair
REDDIT.fix: Get the subreddit's flair templates and send a `flair_id`.

REDDIT.tail: invalid flair template id · that flair doesn't belong to this subreddit
REDDIT.fix: Use a flair template id from this subreddit that isn't mod-only.

REDDIT.tail: this subreddit only allows text posts · the subreddit doesn't allow this post type
this is too long (max: 300) · the title or text is too long
invalid_grant · the refresh token is no longer valid
REDDIT.fix: Have the user authorize the app again.

DISCORD.tail: Missing Permissions · the bot lacks a permission in that channel
DISCORD.fix: Give the bot's role View Channel, Send Messages and Attach Files in the channel (and Manage Webhooks if it posts through webhooks).

DISCORD.tail: Missing Access · the bot can't see the channel or server
Unknown Channel · the channel was deleted
Unknown Webhook · the webhook was deleted
DISCORD.fix: Create a new webhook for the channel and retry.

DISCORD.tail: Unknown Message · the message is already deleted
Invalid Form Body · a field was rejected
Request entity too large · the file is over the upload limit
You are being rate limited. · the rate limit is used up
401: Unauthorized · the bot token is wrong or was reset
DISCORD.fix: Check the bot token in the Discord developer portal and update it where your app stores it.

SLACK.tail: channel_not_found · the channel doesn't exist or the app can't see it

SLACK.tail: missing_scope (needs chat:write.customize) · the install lacks a scope

SLACK.tail: msg_too_long · the text is over 40,000 characters
cant_delete_message · the app can't delete this message
edit_window_closed · the edit window has passed
ratelimited · too many messages too fast
SLACK.fix: Wait for the `Retry-After` seconds, then retry. `chat.postMessage` allows about one message per second per channel.

BLUESKY.tail: Invalid identifier or password · the handle or app password is wrong

BLUESKY.tail: refresh token is invalid, expired or revoked · the OAuth grant is gone
